description: Learn how to store information so your program can remember it.

title: Data Types — Numbers, Text, and More
description: Understand the different kinds of data Python works with.

description: Make programs that ask questions and show answers.

title: Conditionals — Making Decisions
description: Teach your program to choose different actions based on conditions.

title: Loops — Making the Computer Repeat Itself
description: Learn how to make Python run the same code many times without copy-pasting.

title: Functions — Teaching the Computer New Tricks
description: Write reusable blocks of code with your own custom functions.

description: Store multiple values together and work with collections of data.
